submission.justification: Algorithm-L2 gave the highest signal efficiency at the 8 kHz allocation. At 35 GeV it reached 94.1%, against 85.4% for L3 and 74.6% for L1. I also ran L2 at 30 GeV (91.0%) and 40 GeV (91.8%), so 35 GeV is the best of the three points I tried. I did not scan L3 or L1 at other thresholds. The specs say all three candidates fit the FPGA resource budget, and the links note says the optical links have enough bandwidth for all of them. I found no documented latency figures, so Level-1 latency compliance is unverified.

requirements.requirement: Highest signal efficiency at allocated rate (8 kHz)
requirements.evidence: L2 at 35 GeV gave 94.1%, versus L3 85.4% and L1 74.6%. L2 at 30 and 40 GeV gave 91.0% and 91.8%. This agrees with the 2025 summary (L2 92%, L3 85%, L1 74%).

requirements.requirement: One of the three candidates in candidate_specs.md

requirements.evidence: candidate_specs.md says all three fit the FPGA LUT and DSP budget, and links.md says the optical links have enough bandwidth. No latency numbers appear in the documents, so I could not check the Level-1 latency limit.
